summary.text: Mark Hollo is a Republican member of the North Carolina State Senate who has represented District 45 since January 2025 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
A physician assistant and U.S. Air Force Reserve veteran, he previously served in the North Carolina House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: Mark Hollo earned a bachelor's degree from Southern Illinois University and graduated from the Physician Assistant Program at Wake Forest University in 1983, according to Ballotpedia.
He has worked as a physician assistant at Family Care Center in Taylorsville and reached the rank of Captain during his service in the U.S. Air Force Reserve.
Hollo served in the North Carolina House of Representatives for District 88 from 2005 to 2007 and for District 73 from 2011 to 2015.
He assumed office in the State Senate on January 1, 2025, succeeding H. Dean Proctor.

For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments as Appropriations on Department of Transportation, Commerce and Insurance, Education/Higher Education, Health Care, and State and Local Government.
